plan.summary: BRO-5265: 15 show dirs had mutual crossOutletDuplicate 2-cycles (each file named the other as its primary), so both copies were excluded and the review vanished. Clear the flag on the adjudicated keeper of each pair; the other copy stays flagged against it. Part 2 of 2 (long-days-journey-into-night-2016, next-fall-2010, oh-mary-west-end-2025, on-the-twentieth-century-2015, the-bands-visit-2017, the-humans-2016, the-price-2017).
steps: Per pair: write a crossOutletClearReason breadcrumb on the keeper.
Per pair: clear crossOutletDuplicate on the keeper.
